# SIP2.30: Add 1 Ark to LazyVault_HigherRisk_USDC Fleet on mainnet

## Summary
This is a cross-chain governance proposal to add 1 new Ark to the existing LazyVault_HigherRisk_USDC Fleet on mainnet.

## Motivation
Expanding this fleet with additional an Ark will enhance the protocol's capabilities on mainnet.

## Technical Details
- Hub Chain: base (Production)
- Target Chain: mainnet
- Fleet Commander: 0xE9cDA459bED6dcfb8AC61CD8cE08E2D52370cB06
- Number of Ark to add: 1

## New Ark Address
1. `0x5Ebbc493fD41dD607cDAd244a9E6CA7466A3F264`

## Specifications
### Actions
This proposal will execute the following actions on mainnet:
1. Grant COMMANDER_ROLE to Fleet Commander for the Ark
2. Add the Ark to the Fleet Commander

### Cross-chain Mechanism
This proposal uses LayerZero to execute governance actions across chains.
